svg.title: PangoLock: zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS
svg.desc: Arcade cabinet for PangoLock, a zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS in Swift and SwiftUI. The screen plays the key flow: password plus salt, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations, master key checked by a zero-knowledge verifier, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM, an atomic write to a uuid.plock file, decrypt and compare, original removed, vault locked. 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS, a written threat model, Keychain and Touch ID, recovery key, portable lockers, encrypted sharing. MIT licensed, v0.2.1, pre-1.0.
svg.text: THREAT MODEL · CRASH-WINDOW TESTS · RECOVERY KEY · PORTABLE LOCKERS · ENCRYPTED SHARING
